description: Fetches article content, section listings, and metadata from France24.com English edition.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Fetch full article content, title, date, and metadata from a France24 article URL; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_section: Fetch latest articles from a section page (e.g., /en/france/, /en/europe/); 参数: section; 必填: section

url.description: Full URL to a France24 article page (used by get_article)
